single_core_variable: whether a final Japanese surface verifier audits and, when bounded evidence permits, repairs the visible reply so source roles and observable facts are preserved and the already-selected response policy is actually performed
baseline: the retained pre-M39 branch-surface audit, which treats selected/performed policy metadata plus a non-empty Japanese reply as sufficient and does not inspect semantic roles or actual surface act
intervention: post-language-guard M39 semantic/persona surface audit with bounded policy-aware repair; branch selection, M37 relation and M38 linkage remain unchanged
formal_run_rule: After implementation freeze, execute this reserve exactly once. Retain PASS or FAIL without result-driven edits. Any remediation uses a later milestone and a new source-disjoint reserve.

evidence_layers.contract: deterministic verifier audit and repair metrics
evidence_layers.web: isolated Safari turns with visible reply and runtime graph inspection
evidence_layers.human: not available unless separately collected blind ratings exist

claim_boundary: Passing establishes a bounded final-surface integrity mechanism. It does not establish private intent truth, open-domain semantic equivalence, naturalness by human preference, Uruha equivalence, consciousness, or overall superiority to a strong LLM.
